ADVISOR final-slice ruling, verified against current source and signed STORY-1889 comments: PR2917 is independently APPROVED at 88a90b2fd76fe68cc6c114bdbb6125fbec871944, exact-head Build green, public comment6394382434 and canonical PR/parent verdicts recorded. Operator hold retained; final PR4 may continue without parent completion.
For PR4 do not add session_reap.rs::review_pr_terminal_gate to NOT_GATE_AUTHORITY: SIGNOFF09:58 explicitly made that list shrink-only. Source1088 confirms this helper is a pure predicate for dead-reviewer cleanup, not merge authority; nevertheless expanding the exemption would change the signed contract. Resolve the old KNOWN_UNPROTECTED entry with a minimal verbatim move of that helper into protected gate code, adjusting its caller and existing focused tests; preserve its process-exited, branch-within-head, PR-terminal behavior and short-circuiting. Do not rename it merely to evade the ratchet or widen another exemption. Keep the cleanup orchestrator outside. Inventory other actual matches in session_reap before deleting its grandfathered line. This is a bounded plan correction, not a new runtime finding on approved2917. Preserve all other final-slice acceptance, strict reexport ratchet and empty grandfather list. Report any concrete type/privacy obstacle before broadening scope. Local gates remain the agreed targeted area plus fast; touched/compile only shared infra or >10files. No hold clearance or merge.
subject: PR2917 approved; final PR4 must preserve shrink-only exemptions
